text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH - RDMA fabric errors detected on rack rd09 (ToR-12). Elevated packet error rates and CRC/BER counters. Triggering serving errors and CUDA OOMs. Pager routed to oncall-jordan at 02:13 UTC
oncall-jordan: I'm oncall. pulling up graphs and logs now. @sre-alex can you shadow?
sre-alex: on it. I see bursty IB retransmits and QP resets. k8s shows restarts for serving pods on rd09-02, rd09-05, rd09-07.
eng-runtime-maya: seeing KV cache thrash + rehydration spikes. a bunch of generator processes logged OOM while rehydrating missing prefixes.
prod-support-tara: CS: customers in eu-west-2 are seeing 4-10% 5xxs; early tickets created for top impacted tenants. posting pre-alert to status.redwood.ai.
oncall-jordan: quick hypothesis: ToR link instability -> RDMA retransmits -> increased RPC latency -> KV cache miss storms -> sudden memory allocations -> CUDA OOMs -> container crashes.
sre-alex: grabbed dmesg from rd09-02, snip:
```
[02:11:22] mlx5_core 0000:65:00.0: mlx5_hca 0x3: QP 0x7f err state
[02:11:27] rx_miss: eswitch port 12 link flap, RX_OVERRUN
[02:11:29] gdrdriver: gdr_reset invoked
[02:11:31] nv_peer_mem: REMOTE_ACCESS error (22)
[02:11:33] oom-killer: kill process 15021 (serve) score 912
```
eng-runtime-maya: that matches the stack traces we saw in the serving logs: OOMs during cache.rehydrate() calls. example:
```
2026-03-14T02:11:28Z runtime ERROR OOM: alloc 1.9G (GPU0)
  at serving/cache/rehydrate.go:121 rehydrate
  at serving/driver/generate.go:57 Gen
```
oncall-jordan: immediate actions: 1) cordon+drain most impacted nodes 2) enable routing fallback from RDMA to non-RDMA regional pool for affected routes 3) reduce kvcache size and batch caps to limit memory growth 4) notify infra/network for ToR optics/BER check
eng-runtime-maya: executing drain/cordon now:
```
kubectl cordon rd09-02 && kubectl drain rd09-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
kubectl cordon rd09-05 && kubectl drain rd09-05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
kubectl cordon rd09-07 && kubectl drain rd09-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
sre-alex: toggling routing fallback (patching route policy):
```
PATCH /v1/routing/policies
{ "name": "fabric_fallback", "rules": [{"if": "rdma_unhealthy", "action": "route:regional_non_rdma"}] }
```
prod-support-tara: updating customers: "We’ve detected a transient networking issue impacting a subset of hosts in eu-west-2. We’re mitigating and routing traffic to alternate capacity. Status: degraded."
network-ops: investigating. we see ToR-12 counters high for CRC and BER on optics. scheduling traffic shift and optics replacement.
eng-infra: moving mirror traffic off rd09 ToR-12, will RMA optics. opening INFRA ticket INFRA-4521.
eng-runtime-maya: applied temporary configmap changes to reduce memory footprint and slow rehydration:
```
serving.runtime.kv_cache.max_fraction: "0.55"
serving.runtime.batch.max_tokens: "400"
```
oncall-jordan: after drains, container restarts dropped and request failures decreased. p95 latency improved; p99 still elevated for some clients behind fallbacks.
sre-alex: monitoring shows retransmit rate dropping after we shifted traffic away from port 12. However one node rd09-07 still flapping - cordoned and left offline.
prod-support-tara: CS note: impact window ~02:10-02:22 UTC. peak errors ~6.8% for a cohort of EU customers. tickets updated with ETA and contacts.
network-ops: optics RMA queued, temporary link-rate throttle applied to avoid microbursts. recommending ESwitch firmware holdback to v3.2.1 and enabling conservative link down counters.
eng-runtime-maya: to avoid repeat OOM churn we also rolled out a small runtime change: when kvcache miss rate > threshold, introduce randomized staggered rehydrate and backpressure so replicas don't thundering-herd into GPU allocations.
sre-alex: added temporary alert suppression for noisy OOMs to avoid fatigue while we're remediating hardware. documented reason in thread.
oncall-jordan: creating follow-ups: - INFRA-4521 (optics swap) owner: eng-infra - RUNTIME-8732 (kvcache miss detection + backpressure) owner: eng-runtime-maya - POSTMORTEM-386555 (owner oncall-jordan)
prod-support-tara: posting final customer update and will loop in AE for enterprise customers. status page updated to "degraded - mitigations applied".
sre-lee: (handoff) thanks, taking daytime oncall. will own postmortem and ensure fixes prioritized. ping me for any regression.
oncall-jordan: incident moved to resolved state at 02:27 UTC: hardware error (optics/BER) triggered RDMA retransmits -> cascade into KV cache storms and CUDA OOMs. mitigations: node drains, routing fallback, reduced cache/batch sizes, optics RMA scheduled. keeping thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
